Top-down sanity band for external AI-bio expertise services addressable to research labs. Anchor: global AI-in-drug-discovery market USD 3.05B in 2024 (The Insight Partners report 2025-01-27; accessed 2026-09-25; corroborated by Grand View Research USD 2.35B in 2025 and MarketsandMarkets USD 3.92B in 2025 public summaries); assumed 2-10% is lab-facing external expertise/services (remainder is pharma platform software and enterprise contracts); USD converted at ECB EUR/USD 1.1367 (2026-09-24); confidence low because analyst scopes differ materially

Population: life-science wet labs adopting AI/computational workflows but WITHOUT dedicated in-house AI teams - deliberately distinct from p5_venomate's venom/toxin-focused labs so the two active_labs rows do not double-count (packages.yaml notes overlap); anchors: ISCB EDI Annual Report 2025 (accessed 2026-09-25): 4238 memberships as of May 2025; ISMB/ECCB 2025: 2164 in-person participants from 70 countries (ISCB newsletter 2025-07); Vienna BioCenter core facilities serve 759 academic user groups plus 70 companies (VBCF Annual Report 2024); band re-derived 2026-10-06 on D-24 (issue 56): mid 6000 = ~8 major research hubs at VBCF scale discounted for in-house AI teams, high 8000 = the upper extrapolation across those hubs - the superseded 20000 high counted passive adopters beyond the expertise-seeking category and breached the p3 context ceiling; cross-checked against OpenAlex institutions marginal for the p3 queries (data/raw/openalex/2026-10-05); validation target V7

Reasoned estimate of outsourced AI/bioinformatics expertise spend per adopter lab per year - the category P3 actually sells (brokered engagements), not the lab's total tool or staffing budget. Upper anchor: computational-biology consultancy/CRO day rates EUR 600-1200 per day (service catalogues accessed 2026-09-25): high EUR 36k = 2 engagements of 15 days at the EUR 1,200/day ceiling - the superseded EUR 60k high assumed 3 engagements of 20 days, a full-CRO-substitution extreme incompatible with the top-down context band; mid EUR 18k = 2 engagements of ~15 days at ~EUR 600/day; low EUR 5k = 1 engagement of ~8 days at ~EUR 600/day; the institutional bioinformatics-core recharge anchor ~USD 120k/yr serving an entire academic health centre (UT HSC Memphis institutional cores FY23 report accessed 2026-09-25; EUR ~105k at ECB 1.1367 of 2026-09-24) implies EUR 10^2-10^3 per lab when routed through cores - below the band's floor, since the band prices brokered engagements rather than fully core-substituted purchasing; band spans core-substituted to CRO-substituted purchasing patterns; re-anchored 2026-10-06 on D-24 (issue 56)

Analyst capacity estimate (2026-10-05, issue-53 D-06/D-18): brokered fee engagements deliverable by the network per year across the four fee streams Maria's 4 Oct email lists (consultancy, advisory programmes, industry-sponsored collaborations, grant-funded activities) at 1-4/month; validation target V3 (viability: engagement throughput); band aligned to the written basis 2026-10-06 (issue-57 WI-15: 1x12=12 low, 4x12=48 high, mids 2.5x12=30; the superseded 10/20/40 band sat off the basis at both endpoints)

Fee band derived (2026-10-05) from the consultancy/CRO day-rate anchor in row 11 (EUR 600-1200/day, service catalogues accessed 2026-09-25): 2-10 day engagements = EUR 1.2k-12k consultancy, advisory programmes and industry-sponsored collaborations higher; analyst estimate; Maria's email states no commission or platform fee - 'does the platform take a cut?' is an open VMG4 question (D-18)

Top-down sanity band for the research-lab slice of the global custom peptide synthesis market: USD 1078M in 2024 growing to USD 1663.7M by 2030 (Valuates/QY Research Customized Peptide Synthesis report publ. 2024-12-27; accessed 2026-09-25; corroborated by QY Research USD 1228M in 2025 for custom peptide synthesis services); assumed 25-40% from academic + biotech research purchases (Future Market Insights 2025-10: pharma is 40% of the broader USD 5.1B services market); EU sub-market USD 130.8M in 2024 bounds regional share (Persistence Market Research US-EU custom peptide services report); USD converted at ECB EUR/USD 1.1367 (2026-09-24)

Population: academic and biotech wet labs ordering custom peptides at least once per year for research (antibody/immunology work / proteomics assays / chemical biology) - explicitly excludes GMP and therapeutic-manufacturing demand; anchors: University of Utah HSC DNA-Peptide core billed USD 282897 in FY25 serving one mid-size academic health centre (HSC Cores Annual Report FY25 accessed 2026-09-25); Vienna BioCenter core facilities serve 759 academic user groups (VBCF Annual Report 2024); peptide CDMOs report several thousand pharma/biotech plus academic customers (PolyPeptide Annual Report 2022); band re-derived 2026-10-06 on D-24 (issue 56): high 16000 = labs ordering at least annually extrapolated across major research hubs at VBCF scale - the superseded 25000 high counted occasional-order labs beyond the once-a-year category boundary and breached the p4 context ceiling; low 3000 = the annual-ordering floor implied by the CDMO customer counts; reasoned extrapolation of peptide-ordering labs across global research institutions

Triangulated from public price lists accessed 2026-09-25: ProteoGenix from EUR 1.66 per amino acid with EUR 69 minimum per peptide; GenScript from USD 3.20 per amino acid (PSU-GenScript contract sheet 2024-2025); AAPPTec USD 3.50-4.50 per residue crude with USD 125 minimum order; Bachem premium custom tier; typical research lab orders 20-100 peptides/yr at 10-25 residues and crude-to-95% purity => EUR 2k-20k per lab per year; high EUR 20k = 100 peptides x 25 residues at ~EUR 8/residue crude-to-95%-purified blend (~2x the AAPPTec crude rate) - the superseded EUR 40k high was not derivable from the cited per-residue rates; re-anchored 2026-10-06 on D-24 (issue 56); USD converted at ECB EUR/USD 1.1367 (2026-09-24)

Analyst capacity estimate (2026-10-05, issue-53 D-06): one RA-scale disulfide-rich service line at 2-4 syntheses/month incl. folding and characterisation; pilot projects convert indicative prices into approved full-cost tariffs (Maria's 4 Oct email); validation target V4 (viability: throughput at tariff); band aligned to the written basis 2026-10-06 (issue-57 WI-15: 2x12=24 low, 4x12=48 high, mids 3x12=36; the superseded 120 high was 2.5x the basis ceiling)

Top-down sanity band for global annual venom/toxin research tools + data/AI services spend. Anchors: G-FINDER 2024 report (Impact Global Health; publ. 2025-01-30; accessed 2026-09-25): SBE R&D funding USD 31M in 2023 (record; USD 9.2M in 2018) plus Wellcome USD 17M six-year biologics commitment 2024; broader toxinology (scorpion / cone-snail / spider venom drug-lead research) adds non-tracked spend of similar order; assumed 20-50% addressable as tools/services; USD converted at ECB EUR/USD 1.1367 (2026-09-24)

Population: venom/toxin-focused wet labs (venom proteomics / toxin pharmacology / antivenom R&D) active in the last 5 years; anchors: PLOS NTD scientometric analysis 2016 (doi 10.1371/journal.pntd.0005046; accessed 2026-09-25): 3922 institutions published snakebite/snake-venom work through 2015; Animals 2022 bibliometric (doi 10.3390/ani12162058): ~119 snake-venom docs/yr in 2017-2021 and top-10 institutions hold 39.7% of the 1933-2022 corpus; G-FINDER 2019 SBE landscape survey: 62 organisations surveyed / 52 active 2007-2018; reasoned subset of the publishing institutions - excludes general toxicology and clinical-only groups; distinct from p3_marketplace AI-adopter labs; cross-checked against OpenAlex institutions marginal for the p5 venom-peptide queries (data/raw/openalex/2026-10-05, 509 institutions); validation target V8

Category-level spend per venom/toxin wet lab per year on the profiles VenoMate actually sells (re-anchored 2026-10-06 on D-24, issue 56, on a per-lab basis consistent with one profile per facility rather than the superseded platform-total basis of 10 facilities x EUR 400): Maria's 4 Oct 2026 package email (personal communication, package lead) states profile prices EUR 400/yr facility and EUR 2,000/yr industry; the band spans facility-tier to industry-tier intensity — low EUR 400 = one facility profile, mid EUR 2,000 = one industry profile, high EUR 4,000 = two industry profiles; the plan's 10:3 facility:industry mix (€770 blended) sits below the mid but the band must cover higher-intensity adopters; the superseded EUR 9k-68k band read the G-FINDER 2024 report (publ. 2025-01; accessed 2026-09-25) global snakebite-envenoming product R&D funding USD 31M in 2023 across ~50-60 active organisations => ~EUR 0.45M/org/yr all-in at ECB EUR/USD 1.1367 (2026-09-24) times a 2-15% per-lab external-tools share (distinct from the context row's 20-50% addressable share, which measures what fraction of global funding is tools/services rather than what a single lab spends) - a total-budget basis, retained here only as the ceiling sanity check

Maria's 4 Oct 2026 package email (personal communication, package lead), analyst-banded (2026-10-05): year-2 revenue model = 10 facilities x EUR 400 + 3 industry x EUR 2,000 = 13 paying profiles; band 8-20 around the stated plan; validation target V5 (viability: paying-profile conversion)
